label: AbyssHub
description: Run Widgets, read results and files, and trigger workflows on new runs

operations.name: prepare_upload
operations.description: Returns an upload ID and S3 form. Send the form fields and file to upload.url separately, then use the ID in a Widget input.

operations.name: run_widget
operations.description: Starts a paid run and holds for its ending. A busy API or an hour's hold can return queued/running; inspect status and read again.

operations.name: start_widget
operations.description: Starts a paid run with wait=false and returns immediately. Use Get Run or Wait for Run afterwards.

operations.name: get_run
operations.description: Read the current status, result and fresh signed file URLs without waiting.

operations.name: wait_for_run
operations.description: Read with wait=true. A busy API or an hour's hold can return before completion; inspect status.

operations.name: wake_run
operations.description: Restore files from deep storage within 12 hours. AbyssHub emails you when ready. Already awake runs are unchanged.
